person.persName: الحسن بن أحمد بن حسن بن علي بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بدر الدين ابن الامام الشهاب الاذرعي

death.note: Died around the year 880 H (sanat thamānīn taqrīban), having reached middle age (takahhala).

relation.note: His father Aḥmad b. Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Shihāb al-Adhraʿī (AIND-D00665).
"Ḥafiẓa al-Qurʾān wa-jawwadahu ʿalā abīhi": the teacher is his own father (AIND-D00665), not TMP-P-000655 (a different person in ID-Master).

event.desc: Attended the listening of the completion of 『Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī』.

event.note: In this memorization context al-Minhāj = Minhāj al-Ṭālibīn (al-Nawawī). No ref assigned: the ID-Master row "المنهاج = Q6806081" points to al-Minhāj bi-Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim (a different work) — see the pending-decisions file.

person.note: アル＝ハサン・ブン・アフマド・ブン・ハサン・ブン・アリー・ブン・ムハンマド・ブン・アブドゥッラフマーン、バドルッディーン。イマーム・アッ＝シハーブ・アル＝アズライーの息子。ムハンマド・マーミシュの父。母は彼の父に仕えたチェルケス人の女奴隷であった。彼はクルアーンを暗記して父のもとでその朗誦を仕上げ、『ミンハージュ』の一部も暗記した。アル＝ザーヒリーヤ学院で『サヒーフ・アル＝ブハーリー』の読了会を聴聞した。880年頃、壮年に達したのちに亡くなった。

Al-Ḥasan b. Aḥmad b. Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, Badr al-Dīn, son of al-Imām al-Shihāb al-Adhraʿī. Father of Muḥammad Māmish. His mother was a Circassian slave-girl belonging to his father. He memorized the Qurʾān and perfected its recitation under his father, and memorized part of al-Minhāj. He heard the completion of 『Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī』 at al-Ẓāhiriyya. He died around the year 880 H, having reached middle age.
